model.original_model:
<?xml version='1.0' encoding='utf-8'?>
<pnml>
  <net id="original-net" type="http://www.pnml.org/version-2009/grammar/pnmlcoremodel">
    <page id="original-page">
      <place id="source">
        <name>
          <text>Original source</text>
        </name>
        <initialMarking>
          <text>1</text>
        </initialMarking>
      </place>
      <place id="sink">
        <name>
          <text>Original sink</text>
        </name>
      </place>
      <place id="reset-guard">
        <name>
          <text>Original reset-guard</text>
        </name>
      </place>
      <place id="inhibitor-guard">
        <name>
          <text>Original inhibitor-guard</text>
        </name>
      </place>
      <transition id="original-transition-0">
        <name>
          <text>A</text>
        </name>
      </transition>
      <arc id="in" source="source" target="original-transition-0">
        <inscription>
          <text>1</text>
        </inscription>
      </arc>
      <arc id="out" source="original-transition-0" target="sink">
        <inscription>
          <text>1</text>
        </inscription>
      </arc>
      <arc id="reset" source="reset-guard" target="original-transition-0">
        <inscription>
          <text>1</text>
        </inscription>
        <arctype>
          <text>reset</text>
        </arctype>
      </arc>
      <arc id="inhibitor" source="inhibitor-guard" target="original-transition-0">
        <inscription>
          <text>1</text>
        </inscription>
        <arctype>
          <text>inhibitor</text>
        </arctype>
      </arc>
    </page>
    <finalmarkings>
      <marking>
        <place idref="sink">
          <text>1</text>
        </place>
      </marking>
    </finalmarkings>
  </net>
</pnml>
